name: ai-commit-pr-generator
description: Generate AI-powered git commit messages (Conventional Commits) and PR descriptions using OpenRouter or your SSO-authenticated Claude CLI session.

enumDescriptions: Call the OpenRouter HTTP API (requires an API key).
Shell out to the locally installed, SSO-authenticated Claude CLI (no API key).
aiCommitPr.provider.description: Which AI backend to use for generation.

aiCommitPr.openRouterApiKey.markdownDescription: OpenRouter API key. Get one at [openrouter.ai/keys](https://openrouter.ai/keys)

aiCommitPr.model.description: OpenRouter model ID (e.g. nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free, google/gemma-4-31b-it:free, anthropic/claude-3.5-sonnet)

aiCommitPr.claudeCliPath.description: Path to the Claude CLI binary. Override if 'claude' is not on the extension host's PATH (e.g. an nvm install under WSL).

aiCommitPr.includeDiff.markdownDescription: Send the branch diff to the model when generating a PR description. Turn this off to send only the commit history — useful on a private codebase, or to cut token cost on a paid model.

aiCommitPr.baseBranch.description: Base branch for PR diff comparison (main, master, develop, etc.)

aiCommitPr.commitPrompt.description: Custom commit prompt. Use {diff} as placeholder. Leave empty to use the built-in default prompt.

aiCommitPr.prPrompt.description: Custom PR prompt. Use {history} (JSON commit history), {diff} (branch diff) and {template} as placeholders. Leave empty to use the built-in default prompt.
